newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Little Swan plans to offer A shares.
newsitem.headline: Little Swan plans to offer A shares.

text.p: Jiangsu-based washing machine maker Wuxi Little Swan Co Ltd plans to issue 50 million A shares and list them in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Monday.

Little Swan will present the plan to a shareholders' meeting in Wuxi on December 10 and it also requires final approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
He said Little Swan expects to list the A shares in 1997 and use proceeds from the share offer for technological upgrading. A domestic underwriter has yet to be chosen for the issue.

The company plans to expand washing machine production capacity by 2000 from the present 1.20 million, he said but gave no figure. Little Swan listed 70 million B shares in Shenzhen in July this year.

It said in an interim report in August that it had audited net earnings of 96.82 million yuan in the first half of 1996, up 20.72 percent from 1995 because of increased output and sales, according to Chinese accounting standards.
Little Swan has forecast net earnings of 175 million yuan for 1996, against 147 million in 1995.
